title: Copilot Credits: the shared meter for usage-based AI billing
summary: The page needs a billing qualification: its blanket statement that agent flows using other triggers consume credits omits Microsoft's explicit exemption for test runs. The control operations are documented, but some paths stop early and Microsoft pages disagree about currency reporting and exhaustion enforcement.
